name: Dubai
housing: Most Dubai residents rent, mainly apartments in high-rise towers, with villas and townhouses in gated communities.

localRules.text: Every tenancy contract in Dubai must be registered with Ejari, and the Ejari number is needed to connect DEWA utilities.
Many Dubai communities require a move-in permit from the building or community management before moving furniture in.

tenantHelp.name: Rental Disputes Center (RDC)
tenantHelp.what: Dubai's court for rental disputes, including deposits

climate: Test every air conditioning unit and photograph them; summer heat makes a broken AC an urgent repair.
fact: Rents in Dubai are often paid by several post-dated cheques for the year.
